## Candidates

This review compares frozen ObServe 10.0 and ROS LL 4.2.0 catalogues. Correspondences remain unapproved candidates.

Country ISO3 codes match for 93 of 97 source entries. Four exceptions remain unresolved.

Species have 220 exact matches plus the declared RMJ → RMM alias, out of 368 source entries.

All six hull-material homeid values match. Sex, lights and line materials require explicit conversions.

These whole-catalogue counts include disabled entries. They do not measure references used by the 2025 trips.

## To decide

Ports should use UN/LOCODE: 113 of 153 source harbours have one, but the frozen ROS CSV lacks that column.

Hooks need actual type and size together. Artificial-bait AR is a bait-category code, not a species code.

Health, detailed fate and maturity require observation context; their reporting rules remain unresolved.

Sampling and mitigation also need source evidence. Legacy constants do not establish observations.

Registry matching is separate: 102 of 2,741 source vessels have unique IOTC-ID candidates requiring verification.

Observer and contact identities, missing metadata and ambiguous target codes still need review.

Next, examine references used by selected trips and agree the exceptional cases before implementation.
